finding.summary: The surviving CPU and CUDA experiment arms contained one duplicated semantic admission seam even after their fixture/bounds/report helpers had already been consolidated. The common seam belongs in the existing shared experiment contract; CUDA-only shape constraints remain local.
finding.expected_effect: One semantic validator replaces two overlapping check sets while preserving exact revision subject, Boolean support, and middle-axis refusal semantics.
